mods.name: Improved End Rods
mods.description: A mod that adds more end rod types.

releases.notes:
# Improved End Rods v1.0.0

Add colorful and enhanced lighting to your Minecraft world with **Improved End Rods**! This mod expands the vanilla end rod system with vibrant colors and new end rod variants.

## ✨ Features

- **15 Colored End Rods**: Craft end rods in all dye colors except white.
- **Endless End Rods**: Never worry about your lighting going out again - these provide infinite light
- **Broken Variants**: Unique decorative broken end rod blocks
- **Reverse Crafting**: Now you can turn any colored end rod back into a standard white one!
- **Full Recipe Support**: Easy crafting recipes using vanilla end rods + dyes
- **Seamless Integration**: Works perfectly with vanilla Minecraft mechanics
- **Shader Compatible (PBR)**: Works perfectly with shaders like "Complementary Unbound"
  *Use LabPBR in your shaders settings*

## 🔧 Crafting

- **Colored End Rods**: Vanilla End Rod + Any Dye
- **Colored Endless End Rods**: Endless End Rod + Any Dye  
- **Reverse Recipes**: Any Colored End Rod + White Dye.
- **Conversion**: Easy conversion between regular and endless variants
- **Broken**: Blast your end rod and endless end rod to turn them into their broken counterparts

## 📋 Changelog

### [1.0.1] - 2025-08-03
- ➕ Added crafting recipes to convert **colored end rods back into white end rods** (vanilla style).

### [1.0.0] - 2025-07-29
- Initial release with:
  - Colored End Rods (15 colors)
  - Endless End Rods
  - Broken End Rods

## 📋 Requirements

- **Minecraft**: 1.21.1
- **NeoForge**: 1.21.1 (latest recommended)

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the JAR file below
2. Place it in your `mods/` folder
3. Launch Minecraft with NeoForge
4. Enjoy your new and improved end rods!

## 🐛 Known Issues

- None at this time! Report any issues on the GitHub repository.

---

*Perfect for builders, decorators, and anyone who wants more lighting options in their Minecraft world!*
